newsitem.title: UK: Bankers Trust appoints new Middle East director.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust appoints new Middle East director.

text.p: Bankers Trust said on Tuesday it had appointed Richard Jackson as managing director and senior banker to head the firm's corporate coverage for clients located in the Middle East.
Jackson will report to Philippe Souviron, senior managing director and head of Bankers Trust's European Client Coverage effort, the firm said.

Previously, Jackson served as president and chief executive officer of Citistate Corp LTD in Washington D.C. where he directed the acquisition, development, financing and sale of real estate projects in Europe and the the United States.
